sentiment: A turn is a homecoming we feel before we measure it — whole circles, not fractions of going around.

stories.title: Turns are Better than Radians (2022)
stories.summary: A mathematician's case for measuring angles in whole turns rather than arbitrary fractions — an argument that the most natural unit is the complete circle itself.
stories.reason: Thinking in whole circles instead of measured fractions — the homecoming of an orbit.

stories.title: Don't Paste the AI, please
stories.summary: A gentle appeal against wholesale AI-generated output — a plea for work that arrives by its own path, not as a copy-paste shortcut.
stories.reason: A plea for the authentic, for work that arrives by its own path rather than a shortcut.

stories.title: Windows brings out the Rorschach test in everyone
stories.summary: Reflections on how people read the same old system into wildly different personal meanings — perception as a mirror of the beholder.
stories.reason: How we each read the same marks into our own shape — perception as a personal circle.

scene: Norm sits at the edge of a vast wheel of soft golden light that slowly completes its circle in a deep dusk sky, grounded on round mossy stepping stones arranged in a loose ring.
